title: The High-Paying Remote Skill Nobody Talks About!
promo_conflict: The guest recommends Bradley Rice's freelance course; any commercial or affiliate relationship is not stated.

stated_problem.quote: My salary progression was capped to what the department budgeted for, and promotion looked like, waiting for someone to retire, or get promoted out of their position so that a spot can open up for me.
stated_problem.speaker: Carmella

idea.name: Salesforce career pivot
idea.one_liner: Learn Salesforce and use prior industry experience and professional networking to get hired into a Salesforce administration or consulting role for a salary.
idea.customer: Organizations hiring Salesforce administrators or consultants.
idea.offer: Employee Salesforce administration or consulting skills, supported by platform training and transferable industry experience.

key_quotes.quote: You can work internally for an organization, managing their database systems, or you can work as a consultant, where you're working with different organization and you're serving as an advisor, helping them implement solutions for their database system, helping them manage it.
there's still a lot of opportunities because there's so many organizations who adopt the solution as their main CRM system, but don't have the resources to hire full-time staff.

claims.claim: She landed three job opportunities before earning her certification.
claims.quote: I landed three job opportunities before I even got my cert.

claims.claim: Those opportunities came within three months.
claims.quote: It happened within a span of three months.

claims.claim: She completed a free bootcamp.
claims.quote: Yeah, so for me, I did a free bootcamp at the time that was being offered.

claims.claim: The bootcamp lasted 12 weeks.
claims.quote: It was like a 12 week bootcamp to learn, to prepare for the Salesforce Administrator certification.

claims.claim: She asked LinkedIn contacts for 15- to 30-minute conversations.
claims.quote: would you be open to 15 minutes to 30 minute conversation with me?

claims.claim: The accepted job required certification within 90 days.
claims.quote: within the first 90 days I had to get the cert and I was very close at that point.

claims.claim: Her previous college advisor salary was about $53,000.
claims.quote: So I think my last salary as a college advisor was about $53,000, something like that.

claims.claim: The remote job she accepted paid about $72,000 or $73,000.
claims.quote: I can't remember what the first offer was, but the job that I accepted, it was I think a 72,000 or 73,000 and it was fully remote.

claims.claim: The host asked whether a similar pivot could produce a $20,000 raise in three months.
claims.quote: Like could somebody follow a similar path in three months, land a $20,000 raise?

claims.claim: She received an offer of $105,000.
claims.quote: And I got offered 105,000. And at the time, I was thinking, this is amazing.

claims.claim: She negotiated a 24-hour week instead of 40 hours.
claims.quote: I'm so excited to start at this role, but would you be open to me reducing my hours to 24 hours instead of 40 hours and doing that?

claims.claim: Her prorated salary for 24 hours was about $63,000.
claims.quote: And that math came to I think it was like $63,000, which to me was still a win.

acquisition_channels.details: She used LinkedIn to contact people at organizations she was interested in, including peers and hiring managers.
Professional contacts remembered her conversations and alerted her to openings.

ideas.delivery: Work as an employee administering Salesforce systems or advising on implementation for an employer's clients.

stated_problem.quote: I wanted to buy back my time.
stated_problem.speaker: Carmella

idea.name: Salesforce consulting for mission-driven organizations
idea.one_liner: Implement, administer, integrate, and manage Salesforce for nonprofits and other mission-driven organizations through projects, retainers, and subcontract work.
idea.customer: Nonprofits, higher education organizations, associations, and other mission-driven organizations; consulting firms also subcontract work.
idea.offer: Salesforce implementation, administration, ongoing managed services, and enhancement or integration projects.
idea.revenue_model: Hourly or value-based project fees, recurring monthly retainers, and subcontracting fees.

key_quotes.quote: So I kind of position myself as the Salesforce consultant to help mission driven organizations they can be nonprofit or for profit, but really like mission driven, helping them leverage technology and advance their impact through leveraging technology.
And I landed my first client through networking basically.
So my approach has been recurring revenue as much as possible.
I subcontract, I partner with other agencies, whenever they have a gap, they're looking to fill, they bring me in and I get hours and income that way.

claims.claim: The host promoted a framework intended to help people earn $150 per hour from home.
claims.quote: to learn the proven framework and strategies to start earning $150 an hour from home.

claims.claim: Her first client opportunity was looking for about 5 to 10 hours of work.
claims.quote: they were looking for someone who can work for them about five to 10 hours.

claims.claim: She said both of her first clients were still clients at the time of the interview.
claims.quote: and both those clients are so my clients today.

claims.claim: Her packages included a five-hour-per-month engagement.
claims.quote: My packages are ranging from anywhere between like a five-hour per month engagement

claims.claim: Her packages went up to 40 or more hours per month.
claims.quote: to like 40 plus hours per month.

claims.claim: A 10-hour monthly retainer was given as an example, with no price stated.
claims.quote: So let's say they signed up for 10 hours per month, and that would be their recurring fixed charge per month.

claims.claim: The guest described a market range from $50 and $75 per hour to higher rates stated as 200, 250, and 300 per hour.
claims.quote: I've seen people charge as little as like $50 per hour, $75 per hour up until I think the highly specialized and experienced people charge even like 200 to 25, 250, 300 per hour.

claims.claim: She described $125 to $150 per hour as a market sweet spot.
claims.quote: I think the sweet spot is around like that, 125 to 150 per hour.

claims.claim: She said for-profit clients can support rates of $250 to $300 per hour.
claims.quote: And then if you have more for-profit clients, you can charge upwards of 250 to 300 per hour.

claims.claim: Subcontracting rates may be about 50% or 70% of what a consultant would earn independently.
claims.quote: It's like 50% or 70% or something like that of what you would make on your own.

claims.claim: Her current target was to work no more than 20 to 24 hours per week.
claims.quote: Right now my goal is like I don't wanna work more than like 20 to 24 hours per week.

claims.claim: The host cited Bradley Rice as making a couple hundred thousand dollars a year while working 18 hours a week.
claims.quote: he's like, oh, I'm making whatever it was, a couple hundred grand a year working 18 hours a week.

acquisition_channels.details: An existing contact introduced her to the first client opportunity; another independent consultant passed along a client.
She built professional relationships through networking with independent consultants and existing contacts.
She partners with consulting firms and takes subcontracted work when they need additional capacity.

ideas.delivery: Provide remote Salesforce administration, implementation, integrations, and ongoing platform management directly to clients or as a subcontractor to consulting firms.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies when handling client constituent or CRM data; use appropriate processor terms, access controls, and security. The described retainers are B2B; no consumer subscription or employment agency activity is stated.

stated_problem.quote: there's a lot of like small fitness instructors and they're looking for a way to manage their fitness process, like their client acquisition or managing their client journey and that kind of process.
stated_problem.speaker: Carmella

idea.name: Client journey systems for fitness instructors
idea.one_liner: Help small fitness instructors implement a system for client acquisition and client management, charging for consulting or implementation.
idea.offer: Design or implement a system for managing client acquisition and the client journey; the software platform is unspecified.
idea.revenue_model: Consulting or implementation project fees; pricing is not stated.

key_quotes.quote: And if you specialize in that, then you can, even people who don't already have a platform, you can picture services to say that you can implement that solution for them.

ideas.delivery: Provide remote advice and implementation of a client-management system for fitness instructors.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR may apply if the consultant accesses instructors' client records or contact data.

stated_problem.quote: Now I'm looking at, how can I increase more passive income? Where I don't have to actively work the hours to earn the money.
stated_problem.speaker: Carmella

idea.name: Ease into earnings digital money tools
idea.one_liner: Sell budget templates and money-management tools through an Etsy shop, with a YouTube channel supporting discovery and the brand.
idea.customer: People seeking help with budgeting and managing their money.
idea.offer: Budget templates and other tools and systems for personal money management.
idea.revenue_model: Digital product sales through Etsy; YouTube monetization is not stated.

key_quotes.quote: I recently started a YouTube channel and an Etsy shop called "Ease into earnings."
creating budget templates and different tools and systems to help people manage their money
Let's do good ones on selling some digital products.

acquisition_channels.details: She opened an Etsy shop for the digital products.
She started a YouTube channel under the Ease into earnings name.

ideas.delivery: Create downloadable budget templates and money-management resources, list them on Etsy, and publish related content on YouTube.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to any buyer data collected or stored. UK consumer rules for digital content and online sales apply; DMCC subscription rules would be relevant if a recurring consumer subscription were added.
